context.snippet: Seagate Technology (STX) shares were active in extended trading on Tuesday after the storage maker reported fiscal first-quarter results. Read for more. For the period ending Oct. 2, Seagate said it earned an adjusted $7.68 per share as revenue rose 60% year-over-year to $4.2B. Analysts had expected the company to earn an adjusted $7.39 per share on $4.11B in revenue. “Seagate delivered another quarter of record profitability and our highest ever free cash flow in the September quarter, demonstrating the earnings power of our business amid a strengthening demand environment,” said Seagate CEO Dave Mosley in a statement. “Data creation, retention and reuse continue to compound storage demand with long term customer demand visibility reinforcing our view of a multi-year growth phase. Our HAMR-based technology roadmap enables us to address growing exabyte demand through areal density gains while maintaining supply discipline. Combined with our value-based pricing strategy and strengthened balance sheet, we believe Seagate can deliver profitable growth, strong cash generation and increased shareholder returns over the long term.” Looking ahead to the second quarter, Seagate expects to earn between $9 and $9.40 per share on an adjusted basis, well above the $8.66 analysts expected. Fiscal Q1 2027 Highlights Revenue of $4.2 billion GAAP gross margin of 57.3%; non-GAAP gross margin of 57.8% GAAP diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $7.59; non-GAAP diluted EPS of $7.68 Cash flow from operations of $1.7 billion and free cash flow of $1.5 billion Retired $1.2 billion of debt and returned $568 million to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases Increased quarterly cash dividend by approximately 3% to $0.76 per share Seagate Technology Holdings plc (NASDAQ: STX) (the “Company” or “Seagate”), a leading innovator of mass-capacity data storage, today reported financial results for its fiscal first quarter ended October 2, 2026.
SINGAPORE--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Seagate Technology Holdings plc (NASDAQ: STX) (the “Company” or “Seagate”), a leading innovator of mass-capacity data storage, today reported financial results for its fiscal first quarter ended October 2, 2026.
The Board of Directors of the Company (the “Board”) declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.76 per share, which will be payable on January 7, 2027 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on December 23, 2026. The payment of any future quarterly dividends will be at the discretion of the Board and will be dependent upon Seagate’s financial position, results of operations, available cash, cash flow, capital requirements and other factors deemed relevant by the Board. ... The business outlook for the fiscal second quarter of 2027 is based on our current assumptions and expectations; actual results may differ materially as a result of, among other things, the important factors discussed in the Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements section of this release.
